processing: Preserve paths and service game objects; reshape connected rice encounter patches into tapered row runs. Bake original introduction-matched ground, earth, natural path verges, autumn trees and forest-floor falloff into the current 32px tile map.

gids.721-725: original olive ground and grass detail
gids.729-744: original golden earth path masks N=1 E=2 S=4 W=8

grassStep.lifecycle: Initially settled; each grass tile entry plays four bending poses over 400ms. Foreground follows the feet and is clipped below the waist and inside exposed grass edges; final pose remains inside grass and hides immediately on exit.

grassAtlas.connectivityMask: N=1 E=2 S=4 W=8; exposed edges end in whole clumps
grassAtlas.planting: Four flat colors, native 28x22px tall golden grass inspired by ROM encounter grass; 126 overlapping clumps per 128x128 interior, with thinned, uneven whole-clump fringes and up to seven pixels of exposed-edge variation.

ground.placement: Mirror repeats in world coordinates for exact edge matching. Blend leaf variants toward forest edges, soften path corners with irregular grass and earth contours sampled across the whole map, then slice into extruded 32px tiles. Preserve path centers and keep encounter patches clear of collision data.

forestFloor.placement: Original leaf ground at 100% beneath canopy groups, fading by distance to transparent over 64px; scattered leaves share the same falloff at 42% strength. The rendered path mask clips leaves per pixel, retaining continuous foliage on grassy verges and rounded corners. Path interiors and encounter grass stay clear.

bakedForest.placement: Original pixel-art groves at native scale, staggered and depth sorted. Whole sprites move outward where paths or fences narrow the perimeter; protected clearings stay open.
